what: DS1 — the deployment system's model, as the allocation tool reads it

parts.name: credit's own move, rates taken out
the VIX's close, placed in its own year
the VIX's intraday high, placed in its own year
sector funds and equal-weight above their 50-day
sector funds and equal-weight above their 200-day

trendFilter.rule: SPY under its 200-day and most sector funds under theirs, three closes running

trim.name: SPY and QQQ both at RSI 70 or more
their average RSI at 75 or more
both pinned at the top of their range (Williams %R above −10) three sessions running
the VIX in the lowest tenth of its own year
SPY and QQQ further above their 50-day than on nine evenings in ten of the past year
half or more of the core candidates at RSI 70 or more
the core candidates further above their 50-day than on nine evenings in ten of the past year
both at RSI 70+ AND the VIX in its lowest tenth
both at RSI 70+ AND half the core candidates at RSI 70+
both at RSI 70+ AND pinned at the top three sessions
all three: both at RSI 70+, the VIX in its lowest tenth, half the core candidates at RSI 70+
the blend within 1% of its 60-session high while a third or fewer of the sector and equal-weight funds hold their 50-day (added after the first run, because it is today's condition)
RSI was 70+ within ten sessions and has cooled under 60 with price within 2% of the high

scn.measuredOver: the last 500 sessions, sessions where the blend fell half a percent or more
